name: I-DLM-8B
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from Qwen/Qwen3-8B (config.json max_position_embeddings 40960). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
notes: ADDED 2026-10-26. A derivative of Qwen/Qwen3-8B, not a new base model: same config.json, same 8.191 parameters . Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2026-04-07. CAVEATS: Diffusion-LM conversion of Qwen3-8B (not a fine-tune): same weights lineage, retrained for masked-diffusion decoding. Requires the project's own SGLang ISD fork; plain transformers loading does not reproduce these numbers. MATH-500 96.8 vs 95.8 is the ONLY row of 15 where it wins - MMLU 82.4/83.5, GPQA-D 55.6/58.9, AIME-24 69.6/73.1, LiveCodeBench 45.7/50.3 all favour the AR base. Recorded as a single-benchmark win with the regressions stated, not as a general improvement.
